name: RC-B10-0371/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns the detention of five Greek Cypriot citizens with EU citizenship by the Turkish military in the occupied north of Cyprus in July 2025. It calls for their immediate release, medical care, and for the European Commission and the EU's foreign service to act, including possible punitive measures. It also condemns Türkiye's continued occupation of northern Cyprus.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position and demands the five be freed.
- The five detainees, their families, and Türkiye are directly affected.
- Parliament sends its demand to EU institutions and to Türkiye's government and parliament.
